theorem marked_positive_at_actual_AP {ε : ℝ} (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ T : ℕ,4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → Even N → ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Root) (t : ℝ) (p dep : ℕ),
      0≤t → t≤1/12 → 1/((n:ℝ)+1)≤11/384 → p∈originalBand N r →
      ∀ B : Finset (LevelIndex N n r t p dep),
      let Q := rootQ N n r t p; let D := B.image wordProduct; let σ := groupedSigma B wordProduct levelMark
      0≤pairCredit B ∧ signedPositive N Q D σ+pairCredit B≤pairAP B+switchDifference B+ε*markedTheta B
theorem first_parameters : originalW2At 0=parameters

theorem good_dictionary (x : Point) : x∈W2PairDomain (originalW2At 0) 0 ↔
    a0<x 0 ∧ x 0<x 1 ∧ x 1<a2 ∧ x 1+2*x 0<1

theorem three_domains :
    W2PairDomain (originalW2At 0) 1=rectangle a2 a3 ∧
      W2PairDomain (originalW2At 0) 2=triangle a1 ∧
      W2PairDomain (originalW2At 0) 3=rectangle a1 a2
theorem fifth_ordinary_partition : ordinaryIntegral 0 0=ordinaryTriangle a2-badOrdinaryDouble

theorem seed_four_ordinary :
    (∑ k : Fin 4,ordinaryIntegral 0 k)=ordinaryTriangle a2+ordinaryRectangle a2 a3+
      ordinaryTriangle a1+ordinaryRectangle a1 a2-badOrdinaryDouble

theorem box_mem {x : Point} :
    x∈box ↔ a0≤x 0 ∧ x 0≤a2 ∧ a0≤x 1 ∧ x 1≤a3
theorem integrable_raw_box : IntegrableOn raw box

theorem strip_measurable (a b : ℝ) {lo hi : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hl : Continuous lo) (hr : Continuous hi) : MeasurableSet (strip a b lo hi)

theorem strip_integral {a b : ℝ} {lo hi : ℝ → ℝ} (hl : Continuous lo)
    (hr : Continuous hi) (hab : a≤b) (hle : ∀ u∈Ioo a b,lo u≤hi u)
    (hbox : strip a b lo hi⊆box) :
    (∫ x in strip a b lo hi,raw x)=∫ u in a..b,∫ v in lo u..hi u,pairKernel u v
theorem triangle_subset {h : ℝ} (ht : h≤a2) : triangle h⊆box

theorem triangle_integral {h : ℝ} (ha : a0≤h) (ht : h≤a2) :
    (∫ x in triangle h,raw x)=ordinaryTriangle h

theorem rectangle_integral {l r : ℝ} (hl : a0≤l) (hlr : l≤r) (hr : r≤a3) :
    (∫ x in rectangle l r,raw x)=ordinaryRectangle l r
theorem bad_dictionary (x : Point) : x∈bad ↔ (x 0,x 1)∈badDomain
theorem bad_subset : bad⊆box
theorem bad_integral : (∫ x in bad,raw x)=P2SeedOmegaLiteralFunctional.badOrdinaryDouble

theorem raw_fibre (N D : ℕ) (z : ℝ) :
    fibre false N D z=((roughNumbers ((N:ℝ)/D) z).card:ℝ)

theorem rough_receiver_eq_prime_fibre {N d D : ℕ} {z : ℝ} (hN : 4≤N) (he : Even N) (hD : 0<D) :
    ((roughReceiver N d D z).card:ℝ)=fibre true N D z

theorem masked_to_tested {N d D : ℕ} {z : ℝ} (hN : 4≤N) (he : Even N) (hD : 0<D) :
    ((sieveCarrier N D (d*N) z).card:ℝ)≤fibre true N D z+
      ((repeatReceiver N d D z).card:ℝ)+((centerReceiver N d D z).card:ℝ)

theorem raw_word (N : ℕ) (Q : ℝ) (d : ℕ) (cs : List ℕ) :
    wordFibre false N Q d cs=ordinaryWordMass N Q d cs

theorem raw_bad (N : ℕ) (Q : ℝ) (d : ℕ) :
    badFibre false N Q d=ordinaryBad N Q d

theorem prime_word_purified {N d : ℕ} (Q : ℝ) (hN : 4≤N) (he : Even N) (hd : 0<d) (cs : List ℕ) :
    primeWord N Q d cs≤wordFibre true N Q d cs+repeatWordMass N Q d cs+centerWordMass N Q d cs

theorem prime_bad_purified {N d : ℕ} (Q : ℝ) (hN : 4≤N) (he : Even N) (hd : 0<d) :
    originalBadPairCount N Q d≤badFibre true N Q d+badPairRepeat N Q d+badPairCenter N Q d

theorem restricted_prime_purified {N d : ℕ} (Q : ℝ) (hN : 4≤N) (he : Even N) (hd : 0<d) :
    restrictedPrime N Q d≤switchedFibre true N Q d+localErrors N Q d

theorem only_fifth_rejected {N d : ℕ} {Q : ℝ} (hd : 0<d) (hR : 1<Q/(d:ℝ)) :
    sourceRejectedOccurrence N Q d (originalW2At 0) 1=0 ∧
      sourceRejectedOccurrence N Q d (originalW2At 0) 2=0 ∧
      sourceRejectedOccurrence N Q d (originalW2At 0) 3=0

theorem rejected_fifth_eq_original {N d : ℕ} {Q : ℝ} (hd : 0<d) (hR : 1<Q/(d:ℝ)) :
    sourceRejectedOccurrence N Q d (originalW2At 0) 0=originalBadPairCount N Q d

theorem four_rejected_eq_original {N d : ℕ} {Q : ℝ} (hd : 0<d) (hR : 1<Q/(d:ℝ)) :
    (∑ k : Fin 4,sourceRejectedOccurrence N Q d (originalW2At 0) k)=originalBadPairCount N Q d

theorem converted_eq_untested (N : ℕ) (Q : ℝ) (D : Finset ℕ) (σ : ℕ → ℝ) :
    converted N Q D σ=∑ d∈D,σ d*(thetaConversion N d*switchedFibre false N Q d)

theorem purify_on_original_marks {ε : ℝ} (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ T : ℕ,4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → Even N → ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Root) (t : ℝ) (p dep : ℕ),
      0≤t → t≤1/12 → 1/((n:ℝ)+1)≤11/384 → p∈originalBand N r →
      ∀ B : Finset (LevelIndex N n r t p dep),
      switchDifference B≤switchedPPBalance B+ε*markedTheta B

theorem actual_seed_and_four_rounds_at_common_prime_restriction {ε : ℝ} (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ T : ℕ,4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → Even N → ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Root) (t : ℝ) (p : ℕ),
      0≤t → t≤1/12 → 1/((n:ℝ)+1)≤11/384 → p∈originalBand N r →
      let Q := rootQ N n r t p; let S := seedPositions N n r t p
      let D := S.image wordProduct; let σ := groupedSigma S wordProduct levelMark
      let C := ∑ l∈S,levelMark l*trueAt l
      0≤credit N Q D σ ∧ 0≤pairCredit S ∧
        (5*(C-(1-1/50:ℝ)*markedTheta S)+credit N Q D σ+pairCredit S ≤
          ordinaryAP S+switchedPPBalance S+ε*markedTheta S) ∧
        (∀ j : Fin 4,5*(C-(1-originalRound j.succ)*markedTheta S)+credit N Q D σ+pairCredit S ≤
          ordinaryAP S+switchedPPBalance S+5*originalRound j.castSucc*
            (∑ l∈S,levelMark l*physicalFeedback N Q (wordLevel l) (wordProduct l))+ε*markedTheta S)

theorem original_seed_and_four_rounds_at_seven_AP {ε : ℝ} (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ T : ℕ,4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → Even N → ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Root) (t : ℝ) (p : ℕ),
      0≤t → t≤1/12 → 1/((n:ℝ)+1)≤11/384 → p∈originalBand N r →
      let Q := rootQ N n r t p; let S := seedPositions N n r t p
      let D := S.image wordProduct; let σ := groupedSigma S wordProduct levelMark
      let C := ∑ l∈S,levelMark l*trueAt l
      0≤credit N Q D σ ∧ 0≤pairCredit S ∧
        (5*(C-(1-1/50:ℝ)*markedTheta S)+credit N Q D σ+pairCredit S ≤
          ordinaryAP S+switchDifference S+ε*markedTheta S) ∧
        (∀ j : Fin 4,5*(C-(1-originalRound j.succ)*markedTheta S)+credit N Q D σ+pairCredit S ≤
          ordinaryAP S+switchDifference S+5*originalRound j.castSucc*
            (∑ l∈S,levelMark l*physicalFeedback N Q (wordLevel l) (wordProduct l))+ε*markedTheta S)

theorem higher_prime_words {N d : ℕ} (Q : ℝ) (old : PhysicalState)
    (hN : 4≤N) (he : Even N) (hd : 0<d) :
    higherPaidSwitched N Q old d (cutoff Q d (227/50)) (cutoff Q d (353/100))
        (cutoff Q d (29/10)) (cutoff Q d (61/25)) (cutoff Q d (11/5))=longPrime N Q d

theorem mother_positive_split {N d : ℕ} {Q : ℝ} (hN : 4≤N) (he : Even N)
    (hd : 0<d) (hR : 1<Q/(d:ℝ)) :
    localPositivePairs N Q d+actualLocalPrimeMass N Q d ≤
      (∑ k : Fin 4,sourceGoodOccurrence N Q (actualState N) d (originalW2At 0) k)+
        restrictedPrime N Q d+W2Charge N Q d 0
